feedback: Written as the final integration note. The geometry is unchanged from iterations 8 and 9 (215.38, reproduced), and I have used it in the final package. Your feedback request cites kp 3.5 with kd 0.5 as the 215 baseline, but the outcome table shows kp 3.5 with kd 0.5 gave 213.28 (iteration 7), while kp 3.2 with kd 0.5 gave 215.38 (iterations 8 and 9). The learning field also says kp 3.2 at kd 0.5 gave 175, but that score belongs to iteration 10, which used kd 0.4. So the kd 0.5 setting is what holds the score, and kd 0.4 is the setting that lost about 40 points. Oval steering_oscillation at kd 0.5 stayed near 0.29 across kp 3.2 and 3.5, so kp did not change oscillation at this width; kd did. Sensing changes in iterations 1 to 3 all lowered the score, and s-bend max_error has stayed near 0.061 to 0.064 m across track widths 0.10 to 0.09 m, so further geometry changes were not supported by the evidence. No further race remains to test any geometry change.
requested_changes: Keep the geometry exactly as in iterations 8 and 9 (wheel_track 0.09 m, five 12 mm sensors at y = 0.04 m, 0.6 kg). It is the best-measured platform at 215.38.

Correct the kp reference in future feedback: the 215 baseline was kp 3.2 with kd 0.5 (iterations 8 and 9), not kp 3.5. Kp 3.5 with kd 0.5 gave 213.28 (iteration 7), and kd 0.4 gave 174.96 (iteration 10).
